identity: @iobroker/webserver 3.3.2, ioBroker HTTP(S)/HTTP2, certificates and OAuth/OIDC library
decisive_diff: Only executable delta is oauth2.js: /sso now resolves credentials with model.authorize; register rejects anonymous callers (401), rejects other users (403) unless administrator, normalizes user names, and denies group lookup errors. Dependencies unchanged. README records SSO authentication repair. securityChecker.js is byte-identical.
behavior_trace: index.js exports APIs; no install hook, child process, downloaded-code activation, obfuscation or hidden stage identified. TypeScript helpers/sourcemaps are compiler output; all maps have no sourcesContent.

WebServer.init creates HTTP or HTTPS/HTTP2 servers from configured certificates, selects SNI contexts, updates certificate collections, configures CORS, serves published unexpired ACME challenges and reports bound ports to the ioBroker host.

checkPublicIP GETs https://ip.iobroker.in then probes that address on the configured port plus 80/443. _checkURL sets process.env.NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED=0; restores on response/error, but timeout has no explicit restoration. A successful unprotected content match warns the caller. Retained suspicious TLS-disable finding is accurate.

OAuth2Model authenticates incoming bearer/cookie/basic/query credentials, checks passwords with adapter.checkPassword and failed-login backoff, generates random tokens and stores/revokes session pairs locally.

AuthorizationCodeFlow validates registered redirect URIs and S256 PKCE, presents login/consent, stores temporary request/code records, consumes codes once before validation, and issues client/resource-bound tokens.

OIDC fetches configured issuer discovery/JWKS, exchanges codes for tokens, verifies signature/issuer/audience/nonce, consumes expiring state once, maps identity to existing users or links it after caller authorization. No arbitrary third-party credential export found.

rule_changes.evidence: Cookie lookup near token-name literal does not establish browser theft; matcher, proximity, file scopes, severity and exclusion preserved. Removed inherited theft mappings. Explicit hostile replay consumer updated.

TLS context/SNI setup needs no proxy. Consolidated existing context matcher with union of supported scopes, retained MITM consumer. Context creation alone does not create a socket; removed socket-creation mapping.

Sample matched suffix of refresh_token_expires_in:0. Require whole expires_in name and zero value, rejecting decimal/hex prefixes. Zero does not universally mean nonexpiring; Artifactory context stays in admin-scope/audience consumer.
AST requires actual (0, module.randomBytes)(n) invocation. Recovers compiled calls without treating comments, quoted source or method references as generation.

consumer_review: Exact consumers: browser-cookie-replay-auth-token-harvest, javascript-mitm-https-forwarding, nonexpiring-global-admin-token-request, mysql2-tls-connection, node-random-generation.

Audited six broad credential-access/browser or credential-access selectors: lookup alone supplies no theft claim, so its membership was removed rather than adding neutral lookup to theft consumers. Proxy ancestor consumer is PHP-only, disjoint from moved JavaScript TLS facts. No broad cookie-store/token-auth/TLS-initialize/random-crypto selectors found.
No broadening or weakening of suspicious TLS-disable rules; existing SSL-disable finding retained.

tests.result: 11 focused cases passed; hostile cookie replay and Artifactory exploitation plus HTTPS forwarding preserved at original criticality. Existing tls-context-only.js benign fixture and ungated-cookie-hijack/package/steal.js outside batch checked against HEAD baseline; every objective finding on steal.js retained.

material_detection_losses: None. Three relocated observations remain notable. Unsupported Artifactory suffix hit removed. Four OAuth JS members gain random-byte detection; other lost IDs have canonical replacements.

classifier.disagreement: None. Retained suspicious TLS capability is consistent with benign library purpose. Prior release also fires under current rules, contradicting queue clean-baseline premise.

limits: Deployment settings/reachability not supplied; execution paths manually traced despite static flow-producer limitations. Node runtime absent, so optional mocked SSO execution harness could not run. Detection regression checks ran successfully.
Installed classifier warns feature schema v18 predates expected v21.
marker_line: ioBroker webserver 3.3.2: SSO authorization fix; TLS probe unchanged
